summary.name: Beagle IM
summary.one_liner: Beagle IM is a lightweight XMPP chat client for macOS by Tigase, with audio and video calls and OMEMO end-to-end encryption.
use_cases: chatting over the XMPP protocol on a Mac
making audio or video calls to contacts
trying XMPP/Jabber for the first time
summary.what_it_does: Beagle IM is a lightweight XMPP (Jabber) client for macOS made by Tigase, Inc. It supports dark mode and can follow the system theme or a chosen theme. Conversations are shown in a linear layout with all messages aligned left. Markdown formatting can be used in messages. Users can make calls to contacts from within the app, and can join or manage group chats. OMEMO end-to-end encryption can be enabled for private conversations.
notable: Linear conversation layout with all messages aligned left
Markdown formatting supported in every message
Dark mode that follows the macOS system theme
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Only macOS is named as a platform
